sources.authority: Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat (BMI)
sources.title: German identity card (Personalausweis) — physical and electronic features
sources.notes: Personalausweis 2010 introduced eID. 2021 revision introduces PIN-letter workflow. 2024 revision refreshes optical features. TD1 MRZ on back.

sources.title: German travel document number layout
sources.notes: 9-character alphanumeric document number. ICAO 9303 mod-10 check digit on MRZ. Characters I and O are avoided to prevent ambiguity with 1 and 0.

sources.authority: Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat (BMI)
sources.title: German passport (Reisepass) — official feature catalogue
sources.notes: Reisepass 2007 (ePass), 2017 polycarbonate datapage refresh, 2024 latest model. TD3 MRZ. 10-year validity (6 years if holder under 24).

sources.title: Doc 9303 — Machine Readable Travel Documents
sources.notes: TD1 (3x30) and TD3 (2x44) MRZ structure. Check digit weights [7,3,1]. '<' counts as 0, A-Z as 10-35.

sources.title: Steuerliche Identifikationsnummer (Steuer-IdNr) structure
sources.notes: 11 digits. First digit non-zero. In first 10 digits exactly one digit appears twice or thrice; remaining digits each appear at most once. Check digit (11th) is ISO 7064 MOD 11,10.

sources.title: European driving licence — Anlage 8 FeV
sources.notes: EU credit-card licence in DE from 19 Jan 2013. Field 5 is the licence number — no public checksum is published. Card validity 15 years (categories AM, A, B, BE, T). C/D categories: 5 years.

sources.title: Exchange-deadline schedule for pre-2013 German driving licences
sources.notes: Mandatory exchange of all pre-19-Jan-2013 paper/card licences by 19 Jan 2033, staged by birth year and licence year.

sources.title: German driving licence model 2021 / 2025
sources.notes: 2021 EU-aligned refresh. 2025 model introduces updated optical security features. No published checksum for field 5.
